short_description: Plan and produce multi-shot AI videos with SandBase.
description: Plan, generate, assemble, and verify short videos using dynamically selected SandBase image, video, music, speech, lip-sync, and sound-effect models.

requires: Local media tooling for final assembly

install.prompt: Use $video-generator to plan and produce this short video with SandBase media models.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill video-generator --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill video-generator --agent codex --global

examples: Create a 20-second vertical product teaser from these brand references.
Plan a six-shot cinematic launch film and estimate generation cost before running it.
Generate a narrated 16:9 explainer and assemble the final MP4.

optional_inputs: dialogue, narration, music, and sound-effect requirements

notes: Discover and inspect live model capabilities instead of hard-coding provider-specific media endpoints.
Show current pricing and obtain confirmation before the first paid generation call.
Do not duplicate a pending asynchronous run.
Without the six SandBase MCP tools, the Skill supports planning only.

endpoints.summary: Inspect current schema, pricing, limits, and execution requirements.
Execute an approved image, video, or audio model.
Poll an asynchronous media generation run.
Recover recent run status and recorded cost.
Check account balance before a generation batch.
